source_overrides.utub: Melee unit with damage absorption and critical strike.
Strong ranged unit with poison attack. Splits upon death.
The first Treasure Box you build increases your income by 25% every other TB gives 15% less than the one before (i.e. the second gives 21.25% the third 18,06% and so on). |nWatch out, its fragile!

handlers.name: sF
handlers.body:
function sF takes nothing returns nothing
local unit c
set Bv=GetOwningPlayer(Hv)
call GroupEnumUnitsInRect(Nv,gg_rct_MapArea,vr)
set bj_groupRandomConsidered=0
set bj_groupRandomCurrentPick=null
call ForGroup(Nv,function GroupPickRandomUnitEnum)
if(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick==null)then
return
endif
set c=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(Hv),'e008',GetUnitX(Hv),GetUnitY(Hv),.0)
call UnitAddAbility(c,'A00P')
call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,true)
call IssueTargetOrderById(c,$D00FA,bj_groupRandomCurrentPick)
call UnitShareVision(bj_groupRandomCurrentPick,Bv,false)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',20.)
set c=null
endfunction

handlers.name: Gk
handlers.body:
function Gk takes nothing returns nothing
local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(u)
local integer hd=GetPlayerId(p)
local integer wR=GetUnitPointValue(u)
call rI(u)
set wi[hd]=wi[hd]+(cv[wR])
if(dv[wR])then
if(Dv[wR])then
call rd(u,cv[wR]*3/ 4)
else
call rd(u,cv[wR])
endif
else
set Qi[hd]=Qi[hd]+1
endif
call vF(hd,u)
call GroupEnumUnitsOfPlayer(Nv,p,ar)
call ForGroup(Nv,function gd)
set hd=(fv[GetUnitPointValue((u))])
if(hd>0)then
if(Fi[GetPlayerId(p)])then
call IssueImmediateOrderById(u,hd)
call IssueImmediateOrderById(u,hd)
endif
call rj(u,p)
else
set wR=GetUnitTypeId(u)
if(wR=='h001')then
call tf(u)
call GroupAddUnit(Oa,u)
elseif(wR=='h05G')then
call Uf(u)
elseif(wR=='h059')then
call jf(p)
elseif(wR=='h063')then
call qb(p)
elseif(wR=='h02D')then
call TimerStart(Te,4.,true,function QA)
elseif(wR=='h00G')then
call UnitAddAbility(u,'A008')
call UnitAddAbility(u,'A007')
elseif(wR=='h061')then
call pb(u)
elseif(wR=='h056' or wR=='h03L' or wR=='h01W' or wR=='h01X' or wR=='h05R' or wR=='h06F' or wR=='h06E')then
call IssueImmediateOrderById(u,$D027A)
call TriggerSleepAction(1.)
call IssueImmediateOrderById(u,$D027A)
call IssueTargetOrderById(u,$D0279,GroupPickRandomUnit(hr))
call TriggerSleepAction(45.)
call IssueTargetOrderById(u,$D0279,GroupPickRandomUnit(hr))
elseif(wR=='h09T')then
call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09S')
call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09P')
call UnitAddAbility(u,'A09V')
call GroupAddUnit(Da,u)
elseif(wR=='h01O')then
call UnitAddAbility(u,'A01V')
elseif(wR=='h008')then
set wR=GetPlayerId(p)
set yi[wR]=yi[wR]+1
endif
endif
if(ni)then
call II("BE: "+GetPlayerName(p)+" ->"+GetUnitName(u))
call NI()
endif
set u=null
endfunction

handlers.name: Nd
handlers.body:
function Nd takes nothing returns boolean
local unit u=GetFilterUnit()
local boolean iN=GetWidgetLife(u)>.405 and IsUnitEnemy(u,Bv)and IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_SAPPER)and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'Avul')<=0 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A08H')<=0
set u=null
return iN
endfunction

handlers.name: Rd
handlers.body:
function Rd takes unit u returns boolean
	if(Xd(u))then
		call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\DispelMagic\\DispelMagicTarget.mdl",u,"origin"))
		return true
	endif
	return false
endfunction

handlers.name: Xd
handlers.body:
function Xd takes unit u returns boolean
	if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10A')>0)then
		call Vd(u)
		return true
	elseif(GetUnitTypeId(u)=='n01T')then
		if(GetRandomInt(0,99)<60)then
			call Ed(u)
			return true
		else
			return false
		endif
	endif
	return GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A070')>0
endfunction
